summary: This Form 6-K reports a major holdings notification (TR-1) under UK rules, disclosed voluntarily to the SEC. Investment manager Dodge & Cox crossed above the 4.93% voting rights threshold in GSK plc as of April 28, 2026, holding 200,296,898 voting rights (including 111,338,858 ADRs). No issuer action or corporate event is described; it is a routine disclosure of a passive stake crossing the UK notifiable threshold. There are no deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions. This filing carries no special-situation implications and is classified as routine shareholder notification.
